name: @pdpp/list-envelope
description: Shared runtime validator for the bounded-list-page envelope shape ({ object: "list", data: [], has_more, next_cursor }) used by every /_ref/connectors-style paged read. Directly imported by apps/console, packages/operator-ui, and the root-level stream-health-audit script. packages/cli cannot import this private workspace package (it publishes publicly with zero runtime deps), so its copy is a generated artifact of this source (see packages/cli/scripts/generate-list-envelope.ts and scripts/check-generated-artifacts.ts) — never a second hand-maintained implementation.
